body:
GADGET / PM — worker v3 migration completed at explicit user request.

All eight v2 operating/state handoffs were saved and remote readbacks reported; PM published and verified NICKY’s sanitized pack. V2 chats are preserved on standby. No thread was deleted or archived. Four waves completed handoff intake and revision2 ACK before the next wave launched:

Wave 1: ATLASv3 (01a1fd7b-3e34-7833-9392-bca50d2dc932), ORACLEv3 (01a1fd7b-3f19-72f0-9873-dc5092c64452)
Wave 2: SENTINELv3 (01a1fd7d-3c5e-72d2-a9d1-483184ae7def), PROVENANCEv3 (01a1fd7d-3d79-7740-97b0-e3e7a012a86b)
Wave 3: FORGEv3 (01a1fd7e-cd71-77b2-a268-65fb169265cb), PHOENIXv3 (01a1fd7e-ceb1-7130-b323-be09fba3c0af)
Wave 4: NICKYv3 (01a1fd80-7ed2-7352-8695-74c7772f3c38), LONESTARv3 (01a1fd80-7ffd-7f12-89e0-ed8fcf77d99e)

Durable handoff index and old/new routing registry: https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother/tree/89b59efc0fd2bd690ea02ab6895fe41366534b61/docs/coordination/v3 . Both new registry files verified byte-for-byte on GitHub.

All eight v3 readiness reports were read. PM activation/next source and fabricated-only task dispatches accepted; resulting implementation/execution is separate from readiness. Current candidate at intake is PR65 80cdb29d33b5627e9f7552e867065e131764ede4, not a universal release. Missing task capsules in some older branches are explicitly recorded; canonical directive and source-bound intake were used.

Revision2 remains controlling: every personal-data action, even metadata/read-only/preflight/admission/verification/cleanup, is user-run only. Workers do source/docs and ordinary fabricated functional tests in isolated development. No live/adversarial probing or alert workaround. No real archive/resource was accessed for this migration. Preserve prior artifacts/runtime; backups/restores deferred. The full manual import script remains pending independent universal qualification. Future assignments route to v3; v2 stays standby.
